meta.title: Reduce memory usage in ReentrantFileLockTest
meta.body_summary: Reduce subprocess count and iterations in ReentrantFileLockTest to avoid os::commit_memory errors from excessive memory consumption.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex reduced subprocess count and iterations; PR closed immediately by author with no review or merge attempt.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 9 changed lines in a single test file, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It is a trivial test configuration change that was closed immediately without any review discussion.

review_details.concern_detail: No review or comment text available; the PR was closed within minutes of creation with no feedback.

core_change_summary.description: In src/test/java/net/openhft/chronicle/bytes/domestic/ReentrantFileLockTest.java, reduced the number of locker subprocesses from 6 to 3 and reduced iterations per locker from 50 to 20, aiming to lower memory usage during test execution.
change_trajectory: Single commit reduced process count and iteration count.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened and closed by author within ~6 minutes with no review or comment activity.
